title: Russian Drone Incursion Delayed Zelensky Flight to Oslo, Moldova Says
summary: An airspace closure delayed the Ukrainian leader’s trip between Moldova and Norway, officials said. They did not confirm a claim by Norway’s prime minister that a drone had “almost hit” the plane.
